meta.subject: fix weight udpate number issue for mem bus less than atomic_c projects

en.summary: Fixes the generated conversion from fetched-weight delta to weight-entry count so width-mismatched configurations preserve the correct scaled bits.
why_it_counts: Although the patch edits eperl directives, those directives generate DUT RTL for parameterized NVDLA builds.
The changed expression controls how fetched weight bytes are converted into reported weight entries.
An incorrect conversion directly breaks CDMA-to-SC weight update bookkeeping in narrow memory-bus configurations.
evidence: The only touched file is vmod/nvdla/cdma/NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wt.v.
The fix changes the generated incr_wt_entries_w expression in both dmaif>atmc and dmaif<atmc branches.
Nearby code shows incr_wt_entries_w is latched on status_update and later driven out as cdma2sc_wt_entries.
The old expressions used hardcoded low slices and zero-extension, while the new ones preserve ratio-dependent significant bits.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: When a DMA fetch width differs from the compute atomic-C width, the design must rescale a fetched-byte delta into a weight-entry delta. That conversion is essentially a width-ratio shift/slice operation. If the hardware uses hardcoded bit slices or pads with zeros instead of preserving the ratio-dependent significant bits, the reported number of fetched entries becomes wrong even though the raw byte counter is correct.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: width-ratio conversion from fetched-byte delta to entry delta
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Parameter sets where the external memory fetch granule is narrower or wider than one atomic-C weight entry, especially when software or downstream logic consumes periodic weight-update counts.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Restore a hardcoded partial slice/zero-extension conversion so the entry delta drops significant bits under a non-1:1 width ratio.
portability_notes: Target the status/update path that reports how many weight entries were fetched since the previous update, not the main raw byte counter.
This bug is best reproduced on a build where DMA width is smaller than atomic-C width, because right-shift conversion is required and truncation is visible.
Generator code is a valid injection point if it directly produces synthesized DUT RTL for parameterized builds.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the logic that subtracts two fetched-byte counters and converts that delta into a count of fetched weight entries for status or scheduler consumption.
Replace the ratio-aware slice/shift with a hardcoded low-bit slice plus zero extension, or another fixed-width extraction that ignores the configured interface ratio.
Keep the surrounding raw counters unchanged so only the reported entry delta becomes wrong.

repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix rewrites the generated incr_wt_entries_w expression so both dmaif>atmc and dmaif<atmc cases preserve the proper ratio-scaled bits of incr_wt_cnt.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wt.v, restore the old eperl expressions that used {incr_wt_cnt[12:0], zeros} and {{zeros}, incr_wt_cnt[12:k]} instead of the ratio-aware slices now emitted for incr_wt_entries_w.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: CDMA reports the wrong number of fetched weight entries after a status update, causing downstream weight bookkeeping or completion logic to undercount or miscount progress.
evidence_for_injection: incr_wt_entries_w is registered on status_update and exported as cdma2sc_wt_entries.
The modified code is parameterized on the dmaif/atmc ratio, so the bug is explicitly configuration-dependent.
The commit message names the exact failing class: projects where memory bus width is less than atomic_c.
notes: The primary reusable idea is not the exact slice numbers, but the class of bug: wrong bit extraction when rescaling a counter across interface-width ratios.
Because this is generated RTL, validate the reinjected fault on the specific build configuration you care about.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了把“已抓取权重字节增量”转换成“权重 entry 数”的生成逻辑，使位宽不匹配配置下仍能保留正确的缩放有效位。
why_it_counts: 虽然补丁改的是 eperl 指令，但这些指令会直接生成参数化 NVDLA 构建中的 DUT RTL。
被修改的表达式控制着“已抓取权重字节”如何换算成“已抓取权重 entry 数”。
在窄内存总线配置下，错误的换算会直接破坏 CDMA 到 SC 的权重更新记账。
evidence: 修复同时修改了 dmaif>atmc 和 dmaif<atmc 两个分支生成的 incr_wt_entries_w 表达式。
附近代码表明 incr_wt_entries_w 会在 status_update 时锁存，并最终作为 cdma2sc_wt_entries 输出。
旧表达式使用了硬编码的低位切片和零扩展，而新表达式保留了与宽度比例相关的有效位。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 当 DMA 抓取位宽与计算 atomic-C 位宽不一致时，设计必须把“抓取字节增量”重新缩放成“权重 entry 增量”。这个转换本质上是一个与宽度比例有关的移位/取位操作。如果硬件使用了硬编码 bit slice 或错误地补零，而没有保留按比例缩放后的有效位，那么即使原始字节计数是正确的，最终上报的 entry 数也会出错。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 抓取字节增量到 entry 增量的宽度比例转换
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 外部内存抓取粒度与 atomic-C 权重 entry 不是 1:1 的参数配置，尤其是软件或下游逻辑会周期性读取权重更新计数时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 恢复成硬编码的部分切片/零扩展转换，使 entry 增量在非 1:1 宽度比例下丢失有效位。
portability_notes: 目标应是报告“自上次更新以来抓取了多少个 weight entry”的状态路径，而不是主字节计数器本身。
当 DMA 位宽小于 atomic-C 位宽时，这个 bug 最容易复现，因为必须做右移换算，截断效应会更明显。
如果生成器代码会直接产出综合后的 DUT RTL，那么生成器本身就是合法的注入点。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到用两个抓取字节计数器做差，并把该差值转换成抓取 weight entry 数供状态或调度逻辑使用的代码。
把原本与宽度比例一致的 slice/shift 改回硬编码的低位切片加零扩展，或其他忽略接口比例的固定宽度取位方式。
保持外围原始计数器不变，使出错的仅仅是上报出去的 entry 增量。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CDMA 权重更新增量转换的生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 该修复重写了 incr_wt_entries_w 的生成表达式，使 dmaif>atmc 和 dmaif<atmc 两种情况都能保留 incr_wt_cnt 中与宽度比例相匹配的有效位。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 NV_NVDLA_CDMA_wt.v 中，把 incr_wt_entries_w 恢复成旧的 eperl 表达式，即使用 {incr_wt_cnt[12:0], zeros} 和 {{zeros}, incr_wt_cnt[12:k]}，而不是当前按比例选择的切片。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: CDMA 在 status update 后会上报错误的已抓取 weight entry 数，导致下游权重记账或完成判定出现少算或错算。
evidence_for_injection: incr_wt_entries_w 会在 status_update 时锁存，并作为 cdma2sc_wt_entries 输出。
修改代码明确依赖 dmaif/atmc 的比例，因此这是一个显式的配置相关 bug。
提交信息直接点名了失败场景：memory bus width 小于 atomic_c 的工程。
notes: 首要的可复用思想不是具体的位号，而是这类 bug 的本质：跨接口位宽比例重缩放时取位错误。
由于这是生成型 RTL，验证反向注入时应使用目标配置重新生成并测试 DUT。
